description: Defines the MonkeyTrackballEvent class, representing trackball input events in the Android monkey testing framework. It extends MonkeyMotionEvent and specifies event type and source for trackball actions.

classes.name: MonkeyTrackballEvent
classes.description: Represents a trackball input event for Android's monkey testing framework. Extends MonkeyMotionEvent and provides labeling for event type.

methods.name: MonkeyTrackballEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with action type, setting event type and source to trackball.

methods.name: getTypeLabel
methods.description: Returns the string 'Trackball' as the label for this event type.
